mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% over two consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to raise rates and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below 98 for three consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate revenue prospects and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST over two consecutive months signals weakening housing and overall demand, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in CPIAUCSL above 3% in a single month, combined with a simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS, signals inflationary pressure prompting aggressive rate hikes, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS rises in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in PAYEMS above 0.3% month-over-month for four consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in RSAFS above its 12-month moving average for six consecutive months signals increased household savings and reduced consumption, which depresses demand and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 12-month moving average for six consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.
